summary.en: The energy carried by a mechanical wave is proportional to the square of its amplitude, so a wave twice as tall carries four times the energy — a rule that makes intensity fall off far more steeply than amplitude does.
summary.et: Mehaanilise laine kantav energia on võrdeline selle amplituudi ruuduga, seega kannab kaks korda kõrgem laine neli korda rohkem energiat — reegel, mis paneb intensiivsuse langema palju järsemalt kui amplituud.
